description: T-040 statistical (John, 2026-10-16: spawn and wander counts over a fixed number of server ticks; the #72 review: the arena saw no walk-in in 25 minutes on either side). The wander pass moves at most MAXMOVERS (3) monsters a pass over the 300-slot monster cache in slot order (T-086), so a room sees walk-ins only from monsters that are cached and near. A sysop's character keeps three lashworms in room A, looks at them each cycle (which caches them), and watches the next room B for 30 s; stats.py counts the lashworms walking into B during the watches only (`watch` steps, `m2.monster`) and compares walk-ins per minute of watching, the conditional Poisson test, gated. `differential.py run --as USER:PASSWORD`.

mask.why: direction names carry a random capital letter and a backspace
the prompt's numbers only, never its labels (as m4)
the experience after random fights (st, exp): the number and its column padding, not the label
hit points and the maximum the tweak sets (st): the numbers and their padding, not the label

level 1, which the experience allows: a level above it is taken down at the next entry and the stats reset into the editor
